dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Great Four Winds 大四喜 is the loudest hand at the table: you collect all four winds as pungs, and everyone can see it coming.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: It is a limit hand, so it is flat 10 Faan. Even with 門前清 or 自摸 on top, the score stays at 10.

dialogues.speaker: you
dialogues.text: So the extra Faan are simply lost? That feels harsh.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: That is the deal with every 例牌. 10 Faan is the ceiling, so you build for the shape, not the extras.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Small Four Winds 小四喜 keeps one wind as the pair. Great Four Winds turns that pair into the fourth pung, and that one pung is the whole difference.

questions.question: Great Four Winds 大四喜 is a limit hand. How many Faan does it score?
questions.explanation: Every 例牌 is counted as 10 Faan, and Great Four Winds is one of them.

questions.question: A Great Four Winds hand also happens to be 門前清. How many Faan does the whole hand score?
questions.explanation: 10 Faan is the ceiling, so extra Faan such as 門前清 are not added on top of a limit hand.

questions.question: Which statements about Great Four Winds 大四喜 are true?
options: All four winds appear as pungs or kongs
It is scored as a limit hand of 10 Faan
The fourth wind is used as the pair
Extra Faan are added on top of the 10
questions.explanation: Four wind pungs or kongs make the hand, and like every limit hand it is capped at 10 Faan; the pair is an ordinary pair, not a wind.

questions.question: In Small Four Winds 小四喜 the fourth wind is used as the pair. What does Great Four Winds 大四喜 do instead?
options: It uses the fourth wind as a pung as well
questions.explanation: Small Four Winds is three wind pungs plus a wind pair; Great Four Winds upgrades that pair into the fourth pung.

questions.question: Match each hand to its shape.

pairs.right: Four wind pungs, pair from another tile
Three wind pungs, one wind pair as the eyes
Four pungs, winds optional, not a limit hand

questions.explanation: The number of wind pungs separates the two Four Winds hands, while 對對糊 asks for four pungs and says nothing about winds.

questions.question: You hold pungs of {{east}}, {{south}} and {{west}}, plus a pair of {{m5}}. Which tile would upgrade this hand into Great Four Winds?
questions.explanation: The fourth wind is the only missing pung, and {{north}} is the one tile that adds a wind pung here.

questions.question: Your Great Four Winds hand wins by self-draw. What does each of the three opponents pay?
questions.explanation: 10 Faan on a self-draw pays 64 from each player, and the limit cap means the 自摸 Faan adds nothing extra.

questions.question: Arrange the four wind tiles in seat order, starting with East.
questions.explanation: Seat order runs East, South, West, North, which is also the order the winds rotate from hand to hand.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: All Concealed Triplets 坎坎糊 means four pungs you completed yourself, with nobody helping you by discarding into them.

dialogues.speaker: you
dialogues.text: So I cannot claim even one tile from another player?

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Exactly. Four concealed pungs plus a pair is a 10 Faan limit hand, and it grows quietly while everyone else shows their melds.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Two traps: no kongs are allowed at all, and the wait decides whether a discard is allowed to finish the hand.

dialogues.speaker: you
dialogues.text: Then I need to know which waits can take a discard and which ones cannot.

questions.question: All Concealed Triplets 坎坎糊 is a limit hand. How many Faan is it worth?
questions.explanation: 坎坎糊 is one of the 例牌, and every limit hand counts as 10 Faan.

questions.question: Which of these are true requirements for 坎坎糊?
options: No kongs anywhere in the hand
The pair must be a wind pair
questions.explanation: Four pungs you never claimed, and not one kong; a claimed pung or a kong both break the shape, and the pair can be any tile.

questions.question: Why does a single kong disqualify 坎坎糊?
options: A kong is not a concealed pung, so the hand no longer has four concealed triplets
A kong always breaks 門前清 as well
Kongs are only allowed in 十八羅漢
A kong makes the hand too many tiles to score
questions.explanation: 坎坎糊 is defined as four concealed pungs; a kong is a different meld, so the required pattern is simply not there.

questions.question: Your four pungs are already concealed and you hold a lone {{s7}} as the eye wait. Which of these discards can you win on for 坎坎糊?
questions.explanation: On a single wait the four pungs are already complete and concealed, so the discard only pairs the eyes and the hand still counts.

questions.question: A two-pair wait (對碰) cannot take a discard for 坎坎糊. It must be won by ___.
questions.explanation: Winning a two-pair wait on a discard means the last pung is claimed, so that pung is no longer concealed.

questions.question: Match each wait or shape to what it allows.

pairs.left: Single wait 單吊 on the pair

questions.explanation: The wait decides whether a claimed tile would break concealment, and any kong removes the hand from 坎坎糊 altogether.

questions.question: How does 坎坎糊 differ from All Pungs 對對糊 (3 Faan)?
options: 坎坎糊 requires all four pungs to be concealed
坎坎糊 allows chows as well
對對糊 is the higher limit hand
坎坎糊 allows exactly one kong
questions.explanation: 對對糊 only asks for four pungs; 坎坎糊 asks for pungs nobody helped you make, which is why it jumps to a limit hand.

questions.question: You win 坎坎糊 on a discard. How much does the discarder pay?
questions.explanation: A 10 Faan hand on a discard pays 128, and the discarder pays the whole amount alone.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Eighteen Arhats 十八羅漢 is the hand with four kongs. Four kongs plus a pair is 18 tiles, and that is where the name comes from.

dialogues.speaker: you
dialogues.text: So the kongs just sit in front of me while I keep drawing replacement tiles?

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Exactly, and any mix counts: exposed kongs, concealed kongs, even an added kong on a pung you already had.

dialogues.speaker: you
dialogues.text: That sounds like the exact opposite of 坎坎糊, which allows no kongs at all.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Precisely. One hand demands four kongs, the other forbids even one, and both are 10 Faan limit hands.

questions.question: How many kongs must a hand hold to score Eighteen Arhats 十八羅漢?
questions.explanation: Four kongs plus the pair fill the hand, and that is what the name counts.

questions.question: Eighteen Arhats 十八羅漢 is a limit hand. How many Faan does it score?
questions.explanation: Like every 例牌 it counts as 10 Faan, whatever else the hand contains.

questions.question: Why is the hand called Eighteen Arhats 十八羅漢?
options: Four kongs are 16 tiles and the pair adds 2, making 18 tiles
It needs eighteen different tile types
It must be won on the eighteenth draw
questions.explanation: Four kongs hold 16 tiles and the pair adds 2, so the finished hand is literally eighteen tiles.

questions.question: Which of these kongs count toward the four in 十八羅漢?
options: An exposed kong claimed from a discard
An added kong on an existing pung
questions.explanation: Every kind of kong qualifies, concealed, exposed or added; a pung is not a kong, so it adds nothing to the count.

questions.question: Match each hand to the pung shape it requires.

pairs.right: Four concealed pungs and no kongs

questions.explanation: The kong count is the dividing line between these three pung-shaped hands.

questions.question: Three of your melds are already kongs and the fourth is a pung of {{p8}}. Which tile turns that pung into your fourth kong?
questions.explanation: Drawing the fourth {{p8}} upgrades the pung into a kong, and the hand then holds four kongs.

questions.question: You hold four concealed kongs and a pair. Which limit hand does this score?
options: 十八羅漢 only, because kongs rule out 坎坎糊
Both 十八羅漢 and 坎坎糊
Neither, because a concealed kong is not a real kong
questions.explanation: 坎坎糊 requires four concealed pungs and forbids kongs, so a hand full of kongs can only be 十八羅漢.

questions.question: Your 十八羅漢 wins by self-draw. What does each opponent pay?
questions.explanation: 10 Faan on a self-draw is 64 from each of the three players, and the cap keeps the total there.
